questions.q: What does CSPM primarily scan for?
options: Misconfigurations in cloud resource settings against a security baseline
Bugs in application source code
Network bandwidth usage
Employee password strength only
questions.explain: CSPM continuously compares cloud resource configuration against security best-practice baselines, not application code.

questions.q: How does CSPM differ from the vulnerability scanning (CVE/CVSS) covered earlier in this program?
options: Vulnerability scanning finds flaws in code; CSPM finds flaws in configuration
They are the exact same tool with different names
CSPM only runs once per year
Vulnerability scanning only applies to cloud resources
questions.explain: CSPM is the configuration-risk counterpart to vulnerability scanning: same continuous-scanning idea, different layer of risk.

questions.q: According to this lesson, what do post-incident reviews of real cloud breaches commonly find as the root cause?
options: A resource left misconfigured, not a sophisticated exploit
A zero-day vulnerability in the hypervisor
A password strength issue only
An outdated SSL certificate
questions.explain: Most publicized cloud breaches trace back to a resource that was simply left misconfigured, not a novel attack.

questions.q: Why does CSPM scan continuously rather than once?
options: Because cloud environments and their configurations change constantly
Because cloud providers require hourly scans by law
Because one-time scans are technically impossible
Because continuous scanning is cheaper than scanning at all
questions.explain: Posture drifts over time -- a setting that was safe yesterday can be changed today, so CSPM re-scans on a schedule.

questions.q: What is the first step in the CSPM scan cycle described in this lesson?
options: Discover every resource in the environment
Immediately patch every vulnerability found
Disable all public access by default
Notify law enforcement of any finding
questions.explain: A CSPM tool has to inventory every resource before it can compare any of them against the baseline.
